title: Save Search instantsearchjs
body:
I would like to allow users to save their searches.  I have a system in place that parses the URL as an array which allows me to detect what users have been selecting in the facet menu.  I'm using window.location.href.toString() to get the url from the urlsync values.

Say I have a facet search of cars with BMW and Audi as selectable options.

if a user visits a page where BMW cars are shown.  If the user then selects Audi, the `window.location.href.toString()` does not update, it still shows BMW.  It's almost as if `window.location.href.toString()` is not being updated although the correct URL is displayed in the address bar.

```js
{
  url: "savesearch.php",
  type: "POST",
  data: {
    search_url: window.location.href.toString()
  }
}
```

Has anyone else come across this issue or is there a simpler way to achieve this ?

Many thanks

Guy

Sorry about the late answer. I appreciate your patience, thanks.

So if you want to leverage the same search in the backend, you could use the JS Helper [getQuery](https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-helper-js/blob/develop/src/algoliasearch.helper.js#L135-L138). It's not documented but it will give you the Algolia query that you can reuse in the backend for the hits.

However you won't be able to use that back in the front-end. You would have to save the state using `getState` for that.
We'll write a guide about that: see #2189
